Class Flywheel

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.subsystems.Flywheel
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
public final class Flywheel extends Object implements dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
Single-motor flywheel subsystem for a goBILDA Yellow Jacket Planetary Gear Motor. The motor must be configured in the FTC Robot Configuration as a compatible encoder-equipped motor, with the correct gear ratio / ticks-per-revolution. Velocity values are MOTOR-ENCODER ticks per second, not flywheel RPM. The belt drive has a confirmed 1:1 pulley ratio, so flywheel RPM equals motor output-shaft RPM when the belt does not slip. This subsystem controls only the flywheel, not turret, hood or feeder.
